title: Zombie Outbreak Day 3: The Fuel Dock (2/3)

characters.Kai: KAI; one flip-flop left until Part 3, then barefoot
characters.Dana: nurse in teal hospital scrubs, voice [woman]; worked with Tess's mother at Mercy Hospital

scenes.narration: The dock lights are on. The generator is roaring. And every infected in town is walking toward the pier.
Tess pointed at the marina office. A light in the window. Someone waving.
Between them and the office, one long pier. And the infected were already on it.
Sixty of them. Shoulder to shoulder.
Kai looked at the pier. Then at the fuel dock under his feet. It was floating.
A floating dock is joined to the pier by one ramp. And the ramp hangs on two steel pins.
Tess poured diesel on the pin. Diesel creeps into rust like oil.
Kai kicked. The pin flew out. The ramp dropped into the sea.
The infected kept walking. Straight off the end of the pier.
One after another, into the water. They couldn't swim.
But the person in the office was trapped now, with sixty infected between them and the only way out.
Go back? Part three is next.
